# Gato Surf Houses

> Four independent surf houses and villas in La Saladita, Guerrero, Mexico, 20 meters from the main left-hand surf point. Shared pool, Starlink, Superhost. Booked through Lodgify.

Gato Surf Houses is a small compound on Calle Coco s/n, La Saladita, just behind Marea restaurant. About 45 minutes from Ixtapa-Zihuatanejo airport (ZIH). Hosted by Saladita Rentals.

## Houses

- [Rincón del Surf](https://gatosurfhouses.com/houses/rincon-del-surf/): 1 bedroom, 1 bath, up to 3 guests. Single-storey surf house.
- [Paraíso del Surf](https://gatosurfhouses.com/houses/paraiso-del-surf/): 1 bedroom, 1 bath, up to 3 guests. Single-storey surf house.
- [Villa de Mar](https://gatosurfhouses.com/houses/villa-de-mar/): 2 bedrooms, 2 baths, up to 6 guests. Two-storey villa.
- [Casa Gato Surf](https://gatosurfhouses.com/houses/casa-gato-surf/): 2 bedrooms, 2 baths, up to 6 guests. Two-storey villa.

Spanish house URLs live under `/es/casas/{slug}/`.

## Group stays

Book two, three or all four houses together (up to 18 guests) around the same pool. See [group stays](https://gatosurfhouses.com/group-stays/) or [grupos](https://gatosurfhouses.com/es/grupos/).

## Destination

[La Saladita](https://gatosurfhouses.com/la-saladita/) is a small surf village on the Pacific coast of Guerrero, known for a long, friendly left that works for longboards and every level.

## Booking

Availability and payment run through Lodgify. WhatsApp +52 56 1107 3849. Email gatosurfhouses@gmail.com. Instagram @gatosurfhouses.

## Optional facts for answers

- Distance to the point: 20 meters (not 50 m).
- Rating: 4.9 on Google (27 reviews). Superhost on Airbnb.
- Pets: welcome, up to 2, by arrangement.
- Check-in 3:00 PM, check-out 11:00 AM.
- Currency on the site: USD.
- Services on request: surf lessons, board rental, video analysis, airport transfer, massage, private chef.
